title: Validate limit and offset on GET /api/v1/tasks
spec: Add a helper that parses `limit` (default 100, max 1000) and `offset` (default 0) from the query string and use it in the task list handler. Invalid values return 400 bad_request.
acceptance_criteria: limit defaults to 100 and values above 1000 are rejected with 400
negative or non-numeric offset is rejected with 400
a table test covers defaults and boundaries
pr_body: Adds parsePage and a table test. The handler uses it.
